cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll make your coffee. I know this machine. Cup under the outlet, please; this button starts the cycle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's steam. Coffee's behind the flap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Open the flap before selecting coffee, not after. Keep the cup centred under the outlet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It makes two cups unless you turn that dial. I only want one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Turn the dial to one before pressing the coffee button. I'll press it; we don't need two operators for one cup.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 familiar control claim, A3 flap order and A5 portion/button sequence turn B new information into A professional instructions while preserving a calm pose.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 steam distinction causes A3 coffee flap; B4 two-cup default causes A5 dial-to-one and final button control.

relationship.evidence: B2 prevents wrong output and B4 states a real one-cup preference, giving A useful learning clues.

heightening.evidence: A5 adopts B4 unknown control while claiming the sole operator role for the actual coffee.

specificity.evidence: A1 coffee machine, B2 hidden control and B4 dial make the competence gap visible without technical backstory.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 two-operators correction is grounded in the shared actions A has assigned, not invented B haste.
